summary: Full backend + frontend testing of AURA FIT virtual try-on PWA. 14/14 backend pytest cases passed (health, garments catalog, static PNG, session CRUD, updates, heartbeat, QR PNG, validation errors). Frontend Home, Mirror, and Remote pages all render with expected data-testid elements. Bidirectional sync verified: remote clicks correctly POST to /api/sessions and update backend state (selected_garment, fit_mode, view_mode, show_skeleton, clear_garment, swipe next/prev, phone_connected=true, version increments). Invalid remote token correctly shows the 'Session expired' fallback. Mirror page loads gracefully in headless env (fake webcam feed OK, canvas + HUD + QR panel + all controls present, no JS crash).

issues: FPS/pose overlay text near top is mirrored/reversed (transform inherited from mirrored video). Cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py heartbeat endpoint accepts raw dict payload without a Pydantic model — should validate to prevent bad input.
Session tokens have no TTL/expiration; sessions grow unbounded in Mongo. Add periodic cleanup or index with TTL on last_phone_seen for demo hygiene.
phone_connected is only recomputed inside _serialize based on last_phone_seen<10s; stored DB value can drift, but reads always recompute — acceptable.
Home.js and Remote.js: garment images loaded via ${BACKEND_URL}${g.image}. Works since image path starts with /api/static/. Safe.

Remote.js: on 404 (invalid token) getSession catches and shows fallback — good. Heartbeat interval keeps firing every 3s even after error; should be cleared on error to avoid noisy 404s (observed 3x 404 in console).
seed_data_creation: None (garment catalog is hardcoded in server.py)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend 14 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py cover all API surface. Public URL: https://ac6ee5bb-e30b-4d80-b303-523174d822e2.preview.emergentagent.com. Headless Playwright browser presents a synthetic green webcam feed, so 'Camera unavailable' message may not appear (getUserMedia succeeds with fake device), but the mirror UI shell renders correctly with all data-testid elements. Bidirectional sync verified through direct API polling from Playwright request context. Remote heartbeat continues to fire 404s after invalid token — minor UX cleanup only.
